cover of

  • CURIE: gmeow:coverOf
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coverOf
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/creative-works

A flat shortcut asserting that a creative work is a cover version derived from another creative work. The reified form is a gmeow:CreativeDerivation with gmeow:derivationType gmeow:derivationTypeCover.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CreativeWork -> gmeow:CreativeWork Sub-property of: gmeow:wasDerivedFrom

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:coverOf from gmeow:CreativeWork to gmeow:CreativeWork when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:wasDerivedFrom, gmeow:CreativeWork
